material.acceptance_criteria: One export returns the living units' packed columns (or a struct of typed arrays) in one pass; js/client reads that instead of the seven, with unchanged on-screen results.
material.description: rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs:182-239 unit_ids, unit_attacking, unit_strike_target, unit_periods, unit_hps, unit_max_hps, unit_item_gen each loop 0..count with alive() and borrow the host; a frame calls them together with units(). Cost grows with unit count times seven plus seven wasm boundary allocations of Vec per frame.

notes.note: drain-client-10: not taken; the fix is a new rust/crates/web export plus js reads, rust lane drain-rust-9 holds the claim; js side follows once the combined export lands.

Codeinsight callers establish gameMaxHps is called from drawBars -> hud.update -> requestAnimationFrame frame. `unit_columns` packs ids in col 0 and max hp in col 5; layout-site copies rust/crates/web/site/pkg into deployed js/client/pkg. Implementation can replace the two per-frame reads in hud.js with the packed export, retaining fallback for older WASM. Needs correct local artifact and browser witness.
